items.alt: Nobody decides the pairs. Because nobody is showering in pairs. Ever.
items.neu: Nobody decides the pairs. Because nobody is showering in pairs. Ever.

items.alt: Freiwillig zu zweit, wer mag
items.neu: In pairs, voluntarily, for whoever likes.

items.alt: Auf keinen Fall
items.neu: Absolutely not.

items.alt: „Ich gehe mit gutem Beispiel voran.“
items.neu: “I'll lead by example.”

items.alt: Captain! Look at you. Leading from the front. Or the back. Whatever.
items.neu: Boss! Look at you. Leading from the front. Or the back. Whatever works.

items.alt: Nacktbaden mit Folgen
items.neu: Skinny Dipping, with Consequences

items.alt: Lea und Siri waren heute Nacht nackt baden. Elsas Patrouillenboot fuhr genau in dem Moment vorbei. Mit Scheinwerfer.
items.neu: Lea and Siri went skinny dipping last night. Elsa's patrol boat came past at exactly that moment. With a searchlight.

items.alt: So. Lea and Siri went skinny dipping. And Lieutenant Ferrandi's patrol boat had a searchlight. A very good one.
items.neu: So. Lea and Siri went skinny dipping. And Lieutenant Ferrandi's patrol boat has a searchlight. A very good one.

items.alt: It was romantic! The plankton was glowing! And then a boat was glowing. At us.
items.neu: It was romantic! The plankton was glowing! And then a boat was glowing. At us.

items.alt: The coast guard has now seen half our crew naked. I need a rule. I need several rules.
items.neu: The coast guard has now seen half our crew naked. I need a rule. I need several rules.

items.alt: Ist doch nichts passiert
items.neu: Nothing happened, really.

items.alt: Ab jetzt nur noch mit Badesachen
items.neu: From now on, swimwear only.

items.alt: Elsa einen Entschuldigungsbrief schicken, mit Lolas Kuchen
items.neu: Send Elsa a letter of apology, with Lola's cake.

items.alt: Rosi arbeitet zu viel
items.neu: Rosi Works Too Much

items.alt: Rosi hat seit drei Tagen mehr als sechzehn Stunden gearbeitet. Heute ist sie im Maschinenraum im Stehen eingeschlafen. Chiara will, dass Duc es ihr verbietet.
items.neu: For three days Rosi has worked more than sixteen hours a day. Today she fell asleep standing up in the engine room. Chiara wants you to forbid it.

items.alt: Rosi fell asleep standing up today. With a screwdriver in her mouth.
items.neu: Rosi fell asleep standing up today, darling. With a screwdriver in her mouth.

items.alt: I'm fine. One more day, then I sleep. Promise. Maybe. Don't look at me like that.
items.neu: I'm fine. One more day, then I sleep. Promise. Maybe. Don't look at me like that.

items.alt: Order her to rest. She won't listen to me. She listens to you, apparently.
items.neu: Order her to rest. She won't listen to me. She listens to you, apparently.

items.alt: Rosi macht weiter
items.neu: Rosi carries on.

items.alt: Morgen frei, Befehl
items.neu: Tomorrow off. That's an order.

items.alt: Fine. Fine! I'll rest. Aggressively.
items.neu: Fine. Fine! I'll rest. Aggressively.

items.alt: Versprechen an Rosi: „Ich übernehme morgen deine Spätschicht.“
items.neu: Promise to Rosi: “I'll take your late shift tomorrow.”

items.alt: Petrus Preis
items.neu: Petru's Price

items.alt: Petru nimmt kein Geld für seinen Fisch. Er will etwas anderes: Morgen früh sollen zwei von der Crew seine Netze flicken. Drei Stunden, in der Sonne, mit einem alten Mann, der nicht redet.
items.neu: Petru won't take money for his fish. He wants something else: tomorrow morning two of the crew mend his nets. Three hours, in the sun, with an old man who doesn't talk.

items.alt: Petru won't take money for the fish. He wants two of us to mend his nets tomorrow. Three hours.
items.neu: Petru won't take money for the fish. He wants two of us to mend his nets tomorrow. Three hours.

items.alt: Three hours I don't have. Pay the man in euros, like a normal person.
items.neu: Three hours I don't have. Pay the man in euros, like a normal person.

items.alt: He said euros are for tourists. Nets are for friends. I think that's beautiful.
items.neu: He said euros are for tourists, nets are for friends. I think that's beautiful, honestly.

items.alt: Geld anbieten
items.neu: Offer him money.

items.alt: Lea und Duc flicken Netze
items.neu: Lea and Duc mend the nets.

items.alt: Totò schicken, mit Wein
items.neu: Send Totò, with wine.

items.alt: Das Basilikum
items.neu: The Basil

items.alt: In der Messe wachsen jetzt Kräuter. Sehr grüne, sehr buschige Kräuter. Chiara ist sicher, dass es kein Basilikum ist. Totò hält sich die Hand vor den Mund.
items.neu: There are herbs growing in the mess now. Very green, very bushy herbs. Chiara is sure it isn't basil. Totò has a hand over his mouth.

items.alt: Comandante, we have a situation in the mess. A botanical situation.
items.neu: Comandante, we have a situation in the mess. A botanical situation.

items.alt: That is not basil. I have seen basil. Basil does not look like that. Basil does not smell like that.
items.neu: That is not basil. I have seen basil. Basil does not look like that. Basil does not smell like that.

items.alt: It's Australian basil, babe. It's very rare. You wouldn't know it. It's for pesto. Spiritual pesto.
items.neu: It's Australian basil, mate. Very rare. You wouldn't know it. It's for pesto. Spiritual pesto.

items.alt: Raus damit
items.neu: Get rid of it.

items.alt: „Es ist Basilikum.“
items.neu: “It's basil.”

items.alt: Die Pflanze kommt in Lolas Kabine
items.neu: The plant goes to Lola's cabin.

items.alt: Thank you. For your trust. Here, have some pesto. Don't operate any heavy anchors.
items.neu: Thank you. For your trust. Here, have some pesto. Don't operate any heavy anchors after.

items.alt: Siri will umziehen
items.neu: Siri Wants to Move

items.alt: Siri hat Sophia gefragt, ob in einer Crew-Kabine noch ein Bett frei ist. Nur für ein paar Nächte. Yasin hat davon erfahren und steht jetzt im Gang.
items.neu: Siri asked Sophia whether there's a free bunk in one of the crew cabins. Just for a few nights. Yasin has found out, and now he's standing in the corridor.

items.alt: Siri asked if a crew bunk is free. Just for a few nights. Yasin found out. He's in the corridor.
items.neu: Siri asked if a crew bunk is free. Just for a few nights. Yasin found out. He's in the corridor.

items.alt: I just need some space. To sleep. To think. That's all. Please don't make this a thing.
items.neu: I just need a bit of space. To sleep. To think. That's all. Please don't make this a thing.

items.alt: Bro, she's my girlfriend. She sleeps in the VIP cabin. With me. That's not a crew decision.
items.neu: Bro, she's my girlfriend. She sleeps in the VIP cabin. With me. That's not a crew decision.

items.alt: Siri bekommt das Bett
items.neu: Siri gets the bunk.

items.alt: Thank you. Really. You didn't have to.
items.neu: Thank you. Really. You didn't have to.

items.alt: Das klären die beiden selbst
items.neu: Let the two of them sort it out.

items.alt: Siri entscheidet, die Crew hilft nur
items.neu: Siri decides, the crew just helps.

items.alt: Ein Umschlag für Lea
items.neu: An Envelope for Lea

items.alt: Yasin hat Lea einen Umschlag mit tausend Euro gegeben. „Für dich, Süße. Du darfst dich bedanken.“ Lea hält den Umschlag mit zwei Fingern, als wäre er nass.
items.neu: Yasin gave Lea an envelope with a thousand euros in it. “For you, sweetheart. You can thank me later.” Lea holds it between two fingers, as if it were wet.

items.alt: Yasin gave me this. A thousand euros. He said I could thank him later. I don't want to thank him later.
items.neu: Yasin gave me this. A thousand euros. He said I could thank him later. I don't want to thank him later.

items.alt: I just want to give it back. But then he'll be weird. Weirder.
items.neu: I just want to give it back. But then he'll be weird about it. Weirder.

items.alt: A thousand is a thousand, cara. Put it in the crew box. He thanks himself with his mirror.
items.neu: A thousand is a thousand, cara. Put it in the crew box. He can thank himself in the mirror.

items.alt: Zurückgeben, Duc redet mit Yasin
items.neu: Give it back; Duc talks to Yasin.

items.alt: In die Crew-Kasse
items.neu: Into the crew fund.

items.alt: Zurück an Yasin, vor allen beim Frühstück
items.neu: Back to Yasin, in front of everyone at breakfast.

items.alt: Pokerabend bei Alva
items.neu: Poker Night at Alva's

items.alt: Alva lädt zum Poker ins Hinterzimmer. Gespielt wird um Diesel und, wenn es spät wird, um Kleidung. Sophia hat ganz zufällig ein Kartenspiel in der Tasche.
items.neu: Alva is inviting people to poker in her back room. They play for diesel and, when it gets late, for clothes. Sophia just happens to have a deck of cards in her bag.

items.alt: Alva invites us. Poker, back room, tomorrow night. Stakes are diesel. Later, she says, stakes are clothes.
items.neu: Alva invites us, Comandante. Poker, back room, tomorrow night. The stakes are diesel. Later, she says, the stakes are clothes.

items.alt: I'll go. I'm very good at poker. I'm very good at noticing things. Same thing.
items.neu: I'll go. I'm very good at poker. I'm very good at noticing things. Same thing, really.

items.alt: Crew members gambling for fuel. Undressing for fuel. In a bar. Tell me this is a joke.
items.neu: Crew members gambling for fuel. Undressing for fuel. In a bar. Tell me this is a joke.

items.alt: Sophia geht
items.neu: Sophia goes.

items.alt: Nein
items.neu: No.

items.alt: Duc geht mit
items.neu: Duc goes along.

items.alt: Wonderful. Wear something with many layers.
items.neu: Wonderful. Wear something with a lot of layers, darling.

items.alt: Ehrenbürger von Cala d'Orsu
items.neu: Honorary Citizen of Cala d'Orsu

items.alt: Madame Casanova will Duc auf der Festa zum Ehrenbürger machen. Mit Schärpe, Krone aus Muscheln und einer Rede. Die Krone hat sie schon gebastelt. Rosi hat ein Foto.
items.neu: Madame Casanova wants to make you an honorary citizen at the festa. With a sash, a crown of shells and a speech. She has already made the crown. Rosi has a photo.

items.alt: The mayor made you a crown. Out of shells. There is glitter, Duc. So much glitter.
items.neu: The mayor made you a crown, Officer. Out of shells. There's glitter. So much glitter.

items.alt: You have to! You'd be a prince! A shell prince! I'll carry your train!
items.neu: You have to! You'd be a prince! A shell prince! I'll carry your train!

items.alt: The First Officer will not wear a shell crown in public. I forbid it on behalf of the uniform.
items.neu: The First Officer will not wear a shell crown in public. I forbid it on behalf of the uniform.

items.alt: Krone tragen
items.neu: Wear the crown.

items.alt: Ablehnen
items.neu: Decline.

items.alt: Annehmen, aber Chiara hält die Rede
items.neu: Accept, but Chiara gives the speech.

items.alt: Megans Investoren-Dinner
items.neu: Megan's Investor Dinner

items.alt: Megan ist an Bord und will morgen ein Dinner für zwei Investoren geben. Auf der toten Yacht, mit Kerzen. Die Crew soll servieren, als wäre alles normal.
items.neu: Megan is on board and wants to host a dinner for two investors tomorrow. On the dead yacht, by candlelight. The crew is to serve as if everything were normal.

items.alt: Megan wants a dinner tomorrow. Two investors, eight courses, candles. On our dead boat. With a smile.
items.neu: Megan wants a dinner tomorrow. Two investors, eight courses, candles. On our dead boat. With a smile.

items.alt: Darling, a stranded yacht is a story. I sell stories. Your crew serves. Beautifully. Or else.
items.neu: A stranded yacht is a story, First Officer. I sell stories. Your crew serves. Beautifully. Or else.

items.alt: We have rice, tins and one bottle of champagne. My people are exhausted. This is madness.
items.neu: We have rice, tins and one bottle of champagne. My people are exhausted. This is madness.

items.alt: Dinner, wie Megan es will
items.neu: The dinner, the way Megan wants it.

items.alt: Ablehnen
items.neu: Decline.

items.alt: Lola kocht, die Crew isst mit am Tisch
items.neu: Lola cooks, and the crew eats at the table too.

items.alt: The crew. At the table. With my investors. You're either a genius or insane. I'm intrigued.
items.neu: The crew. At the table. With my investors. You're either a genius or insane. I'm intrigued.

items.alt: Eine letzte Nacht
items.neu: One Last Night

items.alt: Morgen entscheidet sich alles. Lola will heute Nacht ein Fest. Chiara will, dass alle schlafen. Beide haben ein bisschen recht.
items.neu: Tomorrow everything gets decided. Lola wants a party tonight. Chiara wants everyone asleep. They're both a little bit right.

items.alt: Whatever happens tomorrow, tonight we dance. Barefoot. On the aft deck. Everyone.
items.neu: Whatever happens tomorrow, tonight we dance. Barefoot. On the aft deck. Everyone.

items.alt: I saved a bottle. And a cake. And a joint, but that's just for me. Mostly.
items.neu: I saved a bottle. And a cake. And a joint, but that's just for me. Mostly.

items.alt: Tomorrow we need clear heads. Everyone in their bunk by midnight. Please.
items.neu: Tomorrow we need clear heads. Everyone in their bunk by midnight. Please.

items.alt: Fest
items.neu: Party.

items.alt: Alle schlafen
items.neu: Everyone sleeps.

items.alt: Fest bis Mitternacht, Duc schickt alle ins Bett
items.neu: Party until midnight, then Duc sends everyone to bed.

items.alt: Das Investoren-Lächeln
items.neu: The Investor Smile

items.alt: Megan braucht ein Foto der Crew für den Newsletter an die Investoren. Alle sollen lächeln. Um 17 Uhr.
items.neu: Megan needs a photo of the crew for the investor newsletter. Everyone is to smile. At five o'clock.

items.alt: Smiles, First Officer. Thirteen of them. Our investors like their crews happy and their yachts upright.
items.neu: Smiles, First Officer. Thirteen of them. Our investors like their crews happy and their yachts upright.

items.alt: Seventeen hundred. Don't be late. I don't do late.
items.neu: Seventeen hundred. Don't be late. I don't do late.

items.alt: „Wird gemacht, Ms McAllister.“
items.neu: “Consider it done, Ms McAllister.”

items.alt: „Die Crew lächelt, wenn sie wieder Strom hat.“
items.neu: “The crew will smile when they have power again.”

items.alt: Nobody says no to me. How refreshing. Do it again sometime.
items.neu: Nobody says no to me. How refreshing. Do it again sometime.

items.alt: Totò bastelt ein altes Foto um
items.neu: Totò doctors an old photo.

items.alt: Auflegen
items.neu: Hang up.

gruppen.titel: hy_lola_tresen · Lola tanzt auf dem Tresen

items.alt: Lola tanzt auf dem Tresen
items.neu: Lola Dances on the Bar

items.alt: Alva ruft aus der Bar an. Hinter ihr tanzt Lola barfuß auf dem Tresen. Die Fischer klatschen.
items.neu: Alva calls from the bar. Behind her, Lola is dancing barefoot on the counter. The fishermen are clapping.

items.alt: O figliolu, your cook is teaching my fishermen to twerk. It's very educational.
items.neu: O figliolu, your cook is teaching my fishermen to twerk. It's very educational.

items.alt: Come and get her. Or don't. Bring nothing but yourself.
items.neu: Come and get her. Or don't. Bring nothing but yourself.

items.alt: CAPTAIN! The universe says hi!
items.neu: BOSS! The universe says hi!

items.alt: Mit dem Tender hinfahren
items.neu: Take the tender over.

items.alt: „Lass sie tanzen, schreib's auf meine Rechnung.“
items.neu: “Let her dance. Put it on my tab.”

items.alt: Chiara anrufen lassen
items.neu: Have Chiara call her.

items.alt: Um 02:13 schreibt Sophia: „Are you awake?“ Dann ruft sie an. Sie liegt im Dunkeln, nur der Bildschirm beleuchtet ihr Gesicht. Das Notizbuch liegt auf ihrer Brust, die Bettdecke ist weit heruntergerutscht.
items.neu: At 02:13 Sophia texts: “Are you awake?” Then she calls. She's lying in the dark, her face lit only by the screen. The notebook rests on her chest, and the duvet has slipped a long way down.

items.alt: I wrote something about you. I want to read it before I lose my nerve.
items.neu: I wrote something about you. I want to read it to you before I lose my nerve.

items.alt: He listens like it costs him nothing, and that is the most expensive thing I've ever been given.
items.neu: He listens like it costs him nothing, and that is the most expensive thing I've ever been given.

items.alt: Okay. That's all. Unless you want to tell me what you'd do if you were here. Slowly.
items.neu: Okay. That's all. Unless you want to tell me what you'd do if you were here. Slowly.

items.alt: „Lies es noch einmal.“
items.neu: “Read it again.”

items.alt: Ihr leise erzählen, was du tun würdest
items.neu: Quietly tells her what you'd do.

items.alt: Keep talking. Don't stop. I'm… my hand is already… God, Duc. Don't stop.
items.neu: Keep talking. Don't stop. I'm… my hand is already… God, Duc. Don't stop.

items.alt: Nur „Gute Nacht, Sophia.“
items.neu: Just “Good night, Sophia.”

items.alt: Nicht drangehen
items.neu: Don't pick up.

items.alt: Holm ruft aus dem Krankenhaus an
items.neu: Holm Calls from the Hospital

items.alt: Holm liegt mit Schläuchen im Arm im Krankenhausbett. Die Brille sitzt schief. Sie sieht blass aus und sehr wütend, dass sie nicht an Bord ist.
items.neu: Holm is lying in a hospital bed with tubes in her arm, her hair down for once. She looks pale, and very angry that she isn't on board.

items.alt: They took my appendix and my boat on the same day. Only one of them I want back. How is she?
items.neu: They took my appendix and my boat on the same day. Only one of them I want back. How is she?

items.alt: Don't lie to me, First Officer. I can hear it in your voice when you lie. You get polite.
items.neu: And don't lie to me, Frankfurt. I can hear it in your voice when you lie. You get polite.

items.alt: Ehrlich erzählen, wie schlimm es ist
items.neu: Tells her honestly how bad it is.

items.alt: Good. Now I know you'll tell me the truth when it matters.
items.neu: Good. Now I know you'll tell me the truth when it matters.

items.alt: Beruhigen: „Alles unter Kontrolle.“
items.neu: Reassures her: “Everything's under control.”

items.alt: Um Rat fragen
items.neu: Asks for her advice.

items.alt: Trust your engineer. Feed your crew. And never let them see you guess.
items.neu: Trust your engineer. Feed your crew. And never let them see you guess.

items.alt: Holm kann nicht schlafen
items.neu: Holm Can't Sleep

items.alt: Holm ruft nachts an. Die Schmerzmittel machen sie gesprächig. Sie erzählt von ihrem ersten Kommando auf einem rostigen Frachter vor Bergen.
items.neu: Holm calls in the middle of the night. The painkillers have made her talkative. She tells you about her first command, a rusty freighter out of Bergen.

items.alt: My first command was a rust bucket out of Bergen. Thirty-one, terrified, nobody listened to me for a month.
items.neu: My first command was a rust bucket out of Bergen. Thirty-one, terrified, and nobody listened to me for a month.

items.alt: Then one night I said I don't know, let's find out together. After that they listened. Funny, hm?
items.neu: Then one night I said, I don't know, let's find out together. After that they listened. Funny, hm?

items.alt: Zuhören bis sie einschläft
items.neu: Listens until she falls asleep.

items.alt: Von dir erzählen
items.neu: Tells her about yourself.

items.alt: „Schlaf jetzt, Captain.“
items.neu: “Get some sleep, Captain.”

items.alt: Megan um 23:40
items.neu: Megan at 23:40

items.alt: Megan ruft um 23:40 an. Sie ist noch im Büro, die Schuhe ausgezogen, ein Glas Whisky in der Hand. Hinter ihr glitzert der Hafen.
items.neu: Megan calls at 23:40. She's still at the office, shoes off, a glass of whisky in her hand. Behind her the harbour glitters.

items.alt: Everyone in this building is afraid of me. It's very boring. Entertain me, First Officer.
items.neu: Everyone in this building is afraid of me. It's very boring. Entertain me, First Officer.

items.alt: And don't mention the boat. I know about the boat. Tell me something nobody tells me.
items.neu: And don't mention the boat. I know about the boat. Tell me something nobody tells me.

items.alt: Etwas Persönliches erzählen
items.neu: Tells her something personal.

items.alt: Mit ihr flirten
items.neu: Flirts with her.

items.alt: Careful. I bite. Contractually.
items.neu: Careful. I bite. Contractually.

items.alt: „Gehen Sie nach Hause, Megan.“
items.neu: “Go home, Megan.”

items.alt: Nobody tells me to go home. …Fine. You first.
items.neu: Nobody tells me to go home. …Fine. You first.

items.alt: Megan will jemanden feuern
items.neu: Megan Wants to Fire Someone

items.alt: Megan hat entschieden, dass jemand aus der Crew gefeuert wird. Duc soll den Namen nennen. Jetzt.
items.neu: Megan has decided that someone from the crew gets fired. You're to name them. Now.

items.alt: I've decided someone gets fired. For morale. Pick a name. You have ten seconds.
items.neu: I've decided someone gets fired. For morale. Pick a name. You have ten seconds.

items.alt: Nine. Eight. I'm counting in my head, it's more threatening.
items.neu: Nine. Eight. I'm counting in my head, it's more threatening.

items.alt: Keinen Namen nennen
items.neu: Gives her no name.

items.alt: Correct answer. It was a test. Nobody ever passes. Ahaha—don't tell anyone I laughed.
items.neu: Correct answer. It was a test. Nobody ever passes. Ahaha— don't tell anyone I laughed.

items.alt: „Dann feuern Sie mich.“
items.neu: “Then fire me.”

items.neu: Suggests Totò, as a joke.

items.alt: Elsas Vorwarnung
items.neu: Elsa's Warning

items.alt: Elsa ruft vom Hafen aus an. Sie redet leise. Morgen früh gibt es eine Razzia wegen Schmuggel in der Bucht. Sie sagt das nicht als Polizistin.
items.neu: Elsa calls from the harbour. She's speaking quietly. Tomorrow morning there'll be a raid for smuggling in the bay. She isn't saying it as a police officer.

items.alt: I never called you. Tomorrow, seven o'clock, we search every boat in the bay. Every locker.
items.neu: I never called you. Tomorrow, seven o'clock, we search every boat in the bay. Every locker.

items.alt: If your bosun has something he shouldn't, tonight is a good night for swimming lessons.
items.neu: If your bosun has something he shouldn't, tonight would be a good night for swimming lessons.

items.neu: “Thank you, Elsa.” Warns Totò.

items.alt: Totò nicht warnen
items.neu: Doesn't warn Totò.

items.neu: “Why are you helping me?”

items.neu: Elsa needs help. A small sailboat is drifting off the bay with two tourists on board and a dead engine. Her patrol boat is too far away.

items.alt: A little sailboat is drifting at the mouth of the bay. Two Germans, no engine, a lot of shouting.
items.neu: A little sailboat is drifting at the mouth of the bay. Two Germans, no engine, a lot of shouting.

items.alt: My boat is twenty minutes out. Your tender is two. Can you help?
items.neu: My boat is twenty minutes out. Your tender is two. Can you help?

items.neu: Lea takes the tender.

items.alt: Duc fährt selbst
items.neu: Duc goes himself.

items.neu: Madame Casanova video-calls you. She's standing on a chair in the piazza, rehearsing her festa speech. She wants honest feedback. She does not want honest feedback.

items.alt: Citizens of Cala d'Orsu! Tonight… a yacht! A giant golden swan has landed in our humble bay!
items.neu: Citizens of Cala d'Orsu! Tonight… a yacht! A giant golden swan has landed in our humble bay!

items.neu: Too much? Be honest. No, don't. Tell me it's perfect. With your eyes.

items.neu: “Perfect.”

items.alt: „Weniger Schwan, mehr Fisch.“
items.neu: “Less swan, more fish.”

items.alt: Less swan… more fish… Genius! You're a genius! I'm adding a fish costume!
items.neu: Less swan… more fish… Genius! You're a genius! I'm adding a fish costume!

items.neu: Laughs.

items.alt: Hiii. I was smoking on the stern and the stars told me to come here. The stars are very bossy tonight.
items.neu: Hiii. I was smoking on the stern and the stars told me to come here. The stars are very bossy tonight.

items.alt: Can I come in? I'm not that high. I'm medium high. High enough to say I've wanted you since the galley.
items.neu: Can I come in? I'm not that high. I'm medium high. High enough to say I've wanted you since the galley.

items.alt: You can say no, Captain. I'll just go back and tell the stars they were wrong. They'll get over it.
items.neu: You can say no, Boss. I'll just go back and tell the stars they were wrong. They'll get over it.

items.alt: Sie hereinlassen
items.neu: Lets her in.

items.alt: Oh, thank god. Lie down. Let me show you what the stars had in mind.
items.neu: Oh, thank god. Lie down. Let me show you what the stars had in mind.

items.alt: Hereinlassen, aber erst reden
items.neu: Lets her in, but talks first.

items.alt: Talking first? You're so sweet it hurts. Okay. Talk to me. Then maybe kiss me. Then maybe more.
items.neu: Talking first? You're so sweet it hurts. Okay. Talk to me. Then maybe kiss me. Then maybe more.

items.alt: „Nicht heute, Lola. Komm wieder, wenn du klar bist.“
items.neu: “Not tonight, Lola. Come back when you're clear-headed.”

items.alt: Respect. Annoying, but respect. I'll come back sober and twice as dangerous.
items.neu: Respect. Annoying, but respect. I'll come back sober and twice as dangerous.

items.alt: Lola schreibt: „Bist du wach?“
items.neu: Lola Texts: “You Awake?”

items.alt: Eine Nachricht von Lola: ein Foto ihres nackten Rückens im Mondlicht und darunter ein einziges Wort: „Again?“ Sie lässt dich den Ort aussuchen. Sie schreibt, die Nacht ist lang.
items.neu: A message from Lola: a photo of her bare back in the moonlight, and underneath, a single word: “Again?” She lets you choose the place. The night is long, she writes.

items.alt: Again? You choose where. I'll be there before you finish reading this. I'm fast when I want something.
items.neu: Again? You choose where. I'll be there before you've finished reading this. I'm fast when I want something.

items.alt: No pressure, babe. If you're tired, send me a heart and I'll dream about you instead. Loudly.
items.neu: No pressure, Boss. If you're tired, send me a heart and I'll dream about you instead. Loudly.

items.alt: Treffpunkt wählen
items.neu: Chooses a place to meet.

items.alt: On my way. Leave the light off. I know the way by heart now.
items.neu: On my way. Leave the light off. I know the way by heart now.

items.alt: Ein Herz schicken
items.neu: Sends a heart.

items.alt: Dreaming about you. Out loud. Sorry, Rosi.
items.neu: Dreaming about you. Out loud. Sorry, Rosi.

items.alt: Nach Feierabend bei Alva
items.neu: After Hours at Alva's

items.alt: Die letzten Fischer sind gegangen. Alva dreht das Schild auf „Chiuso“ und schließt die Tür ab. Sie geht ins Hinterzimmer und kommt in etwas Schwarzem mit Rüschen zurück, das kaum etwas verdeckt. Eine Rose steckt in ihren Locken.
items.neu: The last fishermen have gone. Alva turns the sign to “Chiuso” and locks the door. She goes into the back room and comes back in something black with ruffles that hardly covers anything. There's a rose in her curls.

items.alt: Forty years this bar has been open to everybody. Tonight it's open to one man. Sit, o figliolu.
items.neu: For forty years this bar has been open to everybody. Tonight it's open to one man. Sit, o figliolu.

items.alt: My grandmother danced flamenco in Seville. I only learned the parts that end on a table.
items.neu: My grandmother danced flamenco in Seville. I only learned the parts that end on a table.

items.alt: You can walk out, you know. The door is right there. But you won't.
items.neu: You can walk out, you know. The door is right there. But you won't.

items.alt: Bleiben
items.neu: Stays.

items.alt: Good. Now watch. Don't touch. Not yet. I'll tell you when.
items.neu: Good. Now watch. Don't touch. Not yet. I'll tell you when.

items.alt: Mit ihr tanzen, ganz langsam
items.neu: Dances with her, very slowly.

items.alt: You dance like a sailor. Hold me closer. There. Now you dance like a man who stays.
items.neu: You dance like a sailor. Hold me closer. There. Now you dance like a man who stays.

items.alt: „Heute nicht, Alva.“
items.neu: “Not tonight, Alva.”

items.alt: Then I'll keep the dress on the chair. It's patient. I'm not.
items.neu: Then I'll leave the dress on the chair. It's patient. I'm not.

items.alt: Alva ruft: „Komm vorbei.“
items.neu: Alva Calls: “Come Over.”

items.alt: Alva ruft an. Sie trägt etwas Schwarzes mit weißen Punkten und schwingt einen kleinen Schlüssel an einer roten Kordel vor der Kamera. Den Schlüssel zum Hinterzimmer.
items.neu: Alva calls. She's wearing something black with white polka dots and swinging a small key on a red cord in front of the camera. The key to her back room.

items.alt: I had a key made. For the back room. For you. Nobody else has one, not even my accountant.
items.neu: I had a key made. For the back room. For you. Nobody else has one, not even my accountant.

items.alt: Tonight, or whenever you want. Wherever you want. I'll bring the fan. You know what the fan is for.
items.neu: Tonight, or whenever you want. Wherever you want. I'll bring the fan. You know what the fan is for.

items.neu: Chooses a place.

items.alt: Perfect. Don't eat. I'll feed you after.
items.neu: Perfect. Don't eat. I'll feed you after.

items.alt: „Morgen. Versprochen.“
items.neu: “Tomorrow. I promise.”

items.alt: Koch-Showdown: Kombüse
items.neu: Cook-Off: The Galley

items.alt: Lola hat gehört, dass du kochen kannst. Jetzt steht sie mit verschränkten Armen vor dem Herd. Zwei Kochstellen, eine Stunde, die Crew als Jury. Lola hat schon einen Löffel in der Hand und zielt damit auf dich.
items.neu: Lola has heard that you can cook. Now she's standing in front of the stove with her arms folded. Two burners, one hour, the crew as the jury. Lola already has a spoon in her hand and is pointing it at you.

items.alt: Right. My galley, my rules. One hour, one plate each, the crew votes. Loser does dishes for a week.
items.neu: Right. My galley, my rules. One hour, one plate each, the crew votes. Loser does the dishes for a week.

items.alt: I put twenty euros on the Comandante. Don't look at me like that, Lola, it's business.
items.neu: I put twenty euros on the Comandante. Don't look at me like that, Lola, it's business.

items.alt: Babe, I once made a whole dinner party out of a can of beans and a lime. Bring it.
items.neu: Boss, I once made a whole dinner party out of a tin of beans and a lime. Bring it.

items.alt: Ehrgeizig kochen: dein bestes Gericht
items.neu: Cooks to win: your best dish.

items.alt: Okay. OKAY. That's annoyingly good. Rematch tomorrow. And you're still doing the dishes.
items.neu: Okay. OKAY. That's annoyingly good. Rematch tomorrow. And you're still doing the dishes.

items.alt: „Wir kochen zusammen ein Gericht.“
items.neu: “Let's cook one dish together.”

items.alt: Together? That's not a showdown, that's a date with knives. I love it.
items.neu: Together? That's not a showdown, that's a date with knives. I love it.

items.alt: Sie gewinnen lassen
items.neu: Lets her win.

items.alt: You let me win. I saw it. I'm keeping the trophy anyway.
items.neu: You let me win. I saw that. I'm keeping the trophy anyway.

items.alt: Koch-Showdown: Korsika gegen Saigon
items.neu: Cook-Off: Corsica vs. Saigon

items.alt: Alva hat die Tische zusammengeschoben. Auf der einen Seite stehen ihr Fiadone und ihre Wildschwein-Pastete, auf der anderen deine Garküche aus zwei Gaskochern. Das halbe Dorf ist da. Madame Casanova hat ein Mikrofon mitgebracht.
items.neu: Alva has pushed the tables together. On one side stand her fiadone and her wild boar pâté, on the other your street kitchen of two camping stoves. Half the village is here. Madame Casanova has brought a microphone.

items.alt: Mesdames et messieurs! Corsica against Saigon! Forty years of tradition against one handsome sailor!
items.neu: Mesdames et messieurs! Corsica against Saigon! Forty years of tradition against one handsome sailor!

items.alt: In this bar, o figliolu, the food is older than your country's flag. Cook. Impress me.
items.neu: In this bar, o figliolu, the food is older than your country's flag. Cook. Impress me.

items.alt: Hm.
items.neu: Hm.

items.alt: Thịt kho gegen ihre Pastete
items.neu: Your thịt kho against her pâté.

items.alt: Sweet pork and eggs. Like a grandmother made it. Which grandmother, eh? You'll tell me one day.
items.neu: Sweet pork and eggs. Like a grandmother made it. Which grandmother, eh? You'll tell me one day.

items.alt: Beides auf einen Teller: korsisch-vietnamesisch
items.neu: Both on one plate: Corsican-Vietnamese.

items.alt: Brocciu with fish sauce. I hate that I like it. Don't tell my mother. She's dead and she'd still find out.
items.neu: Brocciu with fish sauce. I hate that I like it. Don't tell my grandmother. She's in Seville and she'd still find out.

items.alt: Das Dorf entscheiden lassen, wer gewinnt
items.neu: Lets the village decide who wins.

items.alt: Democracy! The village votes for everyone! Nobody loses, everybody eats, I give a speech!
items.neu: Democracy! The village votes for everyone! Nobody loses, everybody eats, and I give a speech!

items.alt: Koch-Showdown: Ragù gegen Thịt kho
items.neu: Cook-Off: Ragù vs. Thịt Kho

items.alt: Totò hat einen Topf Ragù aufgesetzt, der seit sechs Stunden simmert. Er behauptet, das Rezept sei älter als die Stadt Neapel. Du hast einen Tontopf mit karamellisiertem Schweinebauch. Rosi verteilt Gabeln wie Waffen.
items.neu: Totò has a pot of ragù on that has been simmering for six hours. He claims the recipe is older than Naples itself. You have a clay pot of caramelised pork belly. Rosi is handing out forks like weapons.

items.alt: Comandante. My nonna's ragù. Six hours. If you lose, you say on camera that Napoli is the centre of the world.
items.neu: Comandante. My nonna's ragù. Six hours. If you lose, you say on camera that Napoli is the centre of the world.

items.alt: And if Duc wins, you say Sicily is better than Napoli. On camera. Yasin, film it.
items.neu: And if the Officer wins, you say Sicily is better than Napoli. On camera. Yasin, film it.

items.alt: Already rolling. This is going to do numbers.
items.neu: Already rolling. This is going to do numbers.

items.alt: Dein Thịt kho gegen sein Ragù
items.neu: Your thịt kho against his ragù.

items.alt: Caramel and pork and egg. Madonna. My nonna would have married you. Don't tell Rosi I said Sicily.
items.neu: Caramel and pork and egg. Madonna. My nonna would have married you. Don't tell Rosi I said Sicily.

items.alt: „Wir tauschen Rezepte.“
items.neu: “Let's swap recipes.”

items.alt: A recipe swap? You know what this is worth in Naples? Everything. Here, my cousin's fish. Fresh. Don't ask.
items.neu: A recipe swap? You know what that's worth in Naples? Everything. Here, my cousin's fish. Fresh. Don't ask.

items.alt: Ihm den Sieg schenken, Neapel loben
items.neu: Gives him the win and praises Naples.

items.alt: Traitor. You'll sleep in the engine room with Unit-01.
items.neu: Traitor. You'll sleep in the engine room with Unit-01.

gruppen.titel: br_lola_flach · Lola liegt flach: Du kochst für 13

items.alt: Lola liegt flach: Du kochst für 13
items.neu: Lola's Down: You Cook for Thirteen

items.alt: Lola hat sich an einer Muschel den Magen verdorben und liegt grün in ihrer Koje. Morgen müssen dreizehn Leute essen. Chiara steht vor dem leeren Kühlplan. Rosi will Dosen und Strom sparen. Sophia will, dass es trotzdem nach Yacht aussieht.
items.neu: Lola ate a bad mussel and is lying green in her bunk. Tomorrow thirteen people need feeding. Chiara is staring at the empty meal plan. Rosi wants tins and to save power. Sophia wants it to look like a yacht anyway.

items.alt: Lola is out. Thirteen people, one galley, zero cooks. Somebody has to stand at that stove tomorrow.
items.neu: Lola is out. Thirteen people, one galley, zero cooks. Somebody has to stand at that stove tomorrow.

items.alt: Cans. Cold. No oven, no hotplate marathon. Every kilowatt goes to the batteries, not to a soufflé.
items.neu: Tins. Cold. No oven, no hotplate marathon. Every kilowatt goes to the batteries, not to a soufflé.

items.alt: If the guests eat beans from a can, they'll talk about it for a year. One proper meal. That's all I ask.
items.neu: If the guests eat beans out of a tin, they'll talk about it for a year. One proper meal, darling. That's all I ask.

items.alt: Rosis Weg: kalte Küche, Strom sparen
items.neu: Rosi's way: cold food, save power.

items.alt: Sophias Weg: ein richtiges Essen
items.neu: Sophia's way: a proper meal.

items.alt: Dritter Weg: Bún riêu im großen Topf, ein Gang, wenig Strom
items.neu: A third way: bún riêu in one big pot. One course, little power.

items.alt: One pot for thirteen. If that works, I'll write it on the whiteboard in gold.
items.neu: One pot for thirteen. If that works, I'll write it on the whiteboard in gold.

items.alt: Versprechen: Lola bekommt morgen als Erste eine Suppe ans Bett
items.neu: Promise: tomorrow Lola gets the first bowl of soup, in bed.

items.alt: Reparatur-Duell: Lolas Mixer
items.neu: Repair Duel: Lola's Blender

items.neu: Lola's blender is dead. Rosi has cleared two workbenches and set up a stopwatch. Whoever gets it running first gets the first glass of Lola's mango smoothie. Lola is standing by with a glass as if it were a trophy.

items.alt: One mixer, two engineers, one stopwatch. If you beat me in my own workshop, I'll call you Maestro for a day.
items.neu: One blender, two engineers, one stopwatch. If you beat me in my own workshop, I'll call you Maestro for a day.

items.alt: Whoever wins gets the first smoothie. The loser gets the one with the bits.
items.neu: Whoever wins gets the first smoothie. The loser gets the one with the bits.

items.alt: I'm timing! Ready, steady, wait, which button is start, okay, GO!
items.neu: I'm timing! Ready, steady, wait, which button is start, okay, GO!

items.alt: Auf Zeit schrauben
items.neu: Works against the clock.

items.alt: Maestro. Ugh. One day only. Don't get used to it. Okay, maybe a little.
items.neu: Maestro. Ugh. For one day only. Don't get used to it. Okay, maybe a little.

items.alt: Zusammen schrauben, eine Hand je Mann

items.alt: Your left hand, my right hand. It works. It shouldn't work. Don't look at me like that.
items.neu: Your left hand, my right hand. It works. It shouldn't work. Don't look at me like that.

items.alt: Rosi gewinnen lassen und ihr den Smoothie reichen
items.neu: Lets Rosi win and hands her the smoothie.

items.alt: You let me win. Sweet. Stupid, but sweet. Drink half.
items.neu: You let me win. Sweet. Stupid, but sweet. Drink half.

items.alt: Harpune zusammenbauen auf Zeit
items.neu: Speargun Assembly Against the Clock

items.alt: Zwei zerlegte Harpunen liegen auf Handtüchern. Chiara hat eine Wette angezettelt. Wer seine schneller zusammenbaut und die Boje trifft, bestimmt, wer heute Abend den Abwasch macht. Sie bindet sich das Haar hoch und lächelt dich an.
items.neu: Two dismantled spearguns are lying on towels. Chiara has started a bet. Whoever assembles theirs faster and hits the buoy decides who does the washing-up tonight. She ties her hair up and smiles at you.

items.alt: Eight parts, one buoy, thirty metres. I've done this blindfolded on a charter in Phuket. You're going down, Officer.
items.neu: Eight parts, one buoy, thirty metres. I've done this blindfolded on a charter in Phuket. You're going down, First Officer.

items.alt: Can you two do this in slow motion? For the algorithm. Chiara, hair flip, please.
items.neu: Can you two do this in slow motion? For the algorithm. Chiara, hair flip, please.

items.alt: Yasin, one more word and the buoy is you.
items.neu: Yasin, one more word and the buoy is you.

items.alt: Schneller sein als sie
items.neu: Beats her to it.

items.alt: Okay. That was fast. That was annoyingly hot and fast. Dishes are mine. Don't gloat.
items.neu: Okay. That was fast. That was annoyingly hot and fast. The dishes are mine. Don't gloat.

items.alt: Ihr beim letzten Teil helfen, damit beide gleichzeitig fertig sind
items.neu: Helps her with the last part so you finish together.

items.alt: A tie. You planned that. Nobody plans a tie. Who are you?
items.neu: A tie. You planned that. Nobody plans a tie. Who are you?

items.alt: Yasins Kamera unauffällig ins Wasser schubsen
items.neu: Nudges Yasin's camera into the water, discreetly.

items.alt: My GoPro! That's a business expense! Siri, stop laughing!
items.neu: My GoPro! That's a business expense! Siri, stop laughing!

items.neu: Lea has brought her field guide up on deck. The game: she describes a sea creature, you have to guess it. Then the other way round. Siri keeps score. Petru sits on the railing mending a net and pretends not to listen.

items.alt: Okay! It's got eight arms, three hearts, blue blood and it can taste with its skin. Go!
items.neu: Okay! It's got eight arms, three hearts, blue blood, and it can taste with its skin. Go!

items.alt: I'm keeping score. Lea is winning, but only because she reads under the blanket at night.
items.neu: I'm keeping score. Lea's winning, but only because she reads under the blanket at night.

items.alt: Too easy.
items.neu: Too easy.

items.alt: Klug raten und ihr dann ein schweres stellen
items.neu: Guesses cleverly, then sets her a hard one.

items.alt: A sea pig? That's a real thing? You're making that up. Petru, is he making that up?
items.neu: A sea pig? That's a real thing? You're making that up. Petru, is he making that up?

items.alt: Absichtlich alberne Antworten geben
items.neu: Gives deliberately silly answers.

items.neu: A seagull is NOT a fish, Duc. Kevin would be so offended.

items.alt: Petru ins Spiel holen
items.neu: Brings Petru into the game.

items.alt: Grouper. Big one. Under the harbour wall. Fifty years old. I call him Napoleon.
items.neu: Grouper. A big one. Under the harbour wall. Fifty years old. I call him Napoleon.

items.neu: Quiz Night: You're the Host

items.neu: You've set up a quiz night. Two teams, a bell from the galley, you as the host. After three rounds it's a draw. Totò is suspiciously often right, and there's a search engine glowing on his phone.

items.alt: The capital of Mongolia? Ulaanbaatar, obviously. I know these things. I am a cultured man.
items.neu: The capital of Mongolia? Ulaanbaatar, obviously. I know these things. I am a cultured man.

items.alt: CHEATER! Ring the bell! Ring the cheating bell!
items.neu: CHEATER! Ring the bell! Ring the cheating bell!

items.alt: Totò disqualifizieren
items.neu: Disqualifies Totò.

items.alt: Disqualified? In Naples this is called research!
items.neu: Disqualified? In Naples this is called research!

items.alt: Totò eine Strafrunde geben: Frage nach seiner Nonna

items.alt: My nonna's birthday? The fourth of March. You see? Some things I don't need a phone for.
items.neu: My nonna's birthday? The fourth of March. You see? Some things I don't need a phone for.

items.alt: Sophia hat einen Poetry Slam ausgerufen. Das Thema hat Lola aus einem Hut gezogen: ihr Kühlschrank. Sophia hat schon vorgelegt, vier Strophen, und Chiara hat dabei geweint vor Lachen. Jetzt bist du dran. Sophia schaut dich über ihr Glas an.
items.neu: Sophia has called a poetry slam. Lola drew the topic out of a hat: her fridge. Sophia went first, four verses, and Chiara cried laughing. Now it's your turn. Sophia looks at you over her glass.

items.alt: O fridge, cold keeper of Lola's sins, you hum all night like a lover who knows too much. Your turn, Duc.
items.neu: O fridge, cold keeper of Lola's sins, you hum all night like a lover who knows too much. Your turn, Duc.

items.alt: That's my fridge she's talking about! It's a good fridge! It's emotionally available!
items.neu: That's my fridge she's talking about! It's a good fridge! It's emotionally available!

items.alt: Make me feel something for an appliance. I dare you.
items.neu: Make me feel something for an appliance, darling. I dare you.

items.alt: Ein Gedicht, frech und warm

items.alt: Gitarre an Deck
items.neu: Guitar on Deck

items.alt: Es ist warm, der Strom reicht für eine einzige Lichterkette. Du hast die alte Gitarre aus dem Salon geholt. Erst sitzt nur Lea da, dann kommen Rosi und Lola mit Decken. Siri bleibt an der Treppe stehen und kommt dann doch näher.
items.neu: It's warm, and there's just enough power for a single string of fairy lights. You've fetched the old guitar from the salon. At first only Lea is sitting there, then Rosi and Lola come with blankets. Siri stops at the top of the stairs, and then comes closer after all.

items.alt: Play something everyone knows! Or something nobody knows! Either! Both!
items.neu: Play something everyone knows! Or something nobody knows! Either! Both!

items.alt: Can you play something quiet? Something that's not for a camera.
items.neu: Can you play something quiet? Something that isn't for a camera.

items.alt: I brought snacks. Tim Tams. For the vibes. Don't ask where I hid them.
items.neu: I brought snacks. Tim Tams. For the vibes. Don't ask where I hid them.

items.alt: Etwas, das alle mitsingen
items.neu: Plays something everyone can sing along to.

items.alt: Okay, I'm singing. Nobody films this. I mean it. Yasin, I mean you, wherever you are.
items.neu: Okay, I'm singing. Nobody films this. I mean it. Yasin, I mean you, wherever you are.

items.alt: Etwas Leises, nur für Siri
items.neu: Plays something quiet, just for Siri.

items.alt: My dad used to play like that. Badly and with his whole heart. Don't stop.
items.neu: My dad used to play like that. Badly, and with his whole heart. Don't stop.

items.alt: Die Gitarre weitergeben
items.neu: Passes the guitar on.

items.alt: Rosi can play? Rosi can PLAY? Why does nobody tell me anything on this boat?
items.neu: Rosi can play? Rosi can PLAY? Why does nobody on this boat tell me anything?

items.alt: Woher du kommst
items.neu: Where You Come From

items.alt: Kein Strom für Musik, nur Kerzen auf dem Achterdeck. Irgendwer hat gefragt, wo du eigentlich herkommst. Es wird still. Alle warten. Niemand drängt. Lola hält dir eine Tasse Tee hin.
items.neu: No power for music, just candles on the aft deck. Someone asked where you actually come from. It goes quiet. Everyone waits. Nobody pushes. Lola holds out a mug of tea to you.

items.alt: You don't have to, babe. But if you want to, we're all here. Nobody's going anywhere. Literally. We're stranded.
items.neu: You don't have to, Boss. But if you want to, we're all here. Nobody's going anywhere. Literally. We're stranded.

items.alt: You always ask about us. You never talk about you. Where does the First Officer come from?
items.neu: You always ask about us. You never talk about you. Where does the First Officer come from?

items.alt: Deine Geschichte erzählen: Familie, Flucht, der Weg nach oben
items.neu: Tells your story: family, flight, the long way up.

items.alt: Take your time. We've got all night and nowhere to be.
items.neu: Take your time. We've got all night and nowhere to be.

items.alt: Nur einer Person erzählen, später, unter vier Augen
items.neu: Tells only one person, later, in private.

items.alt: Okay. Whoever he picks, the rest of us are going to bed and absolutely not listening at the door.
items.neu: Okay. Whoever he picks, the rest of us are going to bed and absolutely not listening at the door.

items.alt: Abwinken: „Ein andermal.“
items.neu: Waves it off: “Another time.”

items.alt: Okay. The offer stays open. That's how it works on a boat.
items.neu: Okay. The offer stays open. That's how it works on a boat.

items.alt: Ein Anruf aus Köln
items.neu: A Call from Cologne

items.alt: Eine Nummer aus Köln. Es ist Katrin Vogel, die Personalberaterin. Der Vorstand will bis Ende der Woche deine Antwort auf die Stelle: Leitung Nachhaltigkeit Europa. Hinter dir lacht jemand an Deck. Niemand an Bord weiß davon.
items.neu: A Cologne number. It's Katrin Vogel, the headhunter. The board wants your answer about the job by the end of the week: Head of Sustainability, Europe. Behind you someone laughs on deck. Nobody on board knows about this.

items.alt: Katrin Vogel speaking. I'll be brief: the board wants your answer by Friday. Head of Sustainability, Europe.
items.neu: Katrin Vogel speaking. I'll be brief: the board wants your answer by Friday. Head of Sustainability, Europe.

items.alt: Cologne, a team of forty, a very good package. And an office. I gather you're somewhere with a lot of water.
items.neu: Cologne, a team of forty, a very good package. And an office. I gather you're somewhere with a lot of water.

items.alt: I need to tell them something today. Yes, no, or a date. A date is fine. Silence is not.
items.neu: I need to tell them something today. Yes, no, or a date. A date is fine. Silence is not.

items.alt: Vertrösten: „Freitag bekommen Sie meine Antwort.“
items.neu: Stalls: “You'll have my answer on Friday.”

items.alt: Friday, then. I'll hold them off until then. Not a day longer.
items.neu: Friday, then. I'll hold them off until then. Not a day longer.

items.alt: Zusagen, heimlich
items.neu: Accepts, secretly.

items.alt: Wonderful. I'll send the contract. Enjoy the sea while it lasts.
items.neu: Wonderful. I'll send the contract. Enjoy the sea while it lasts.

items.alt: Absagen: „Mein Platz ist hier.“
items.neu: Turns it down: “My place is here.”

items.alt: That's a first. Most people at least negotiate. The door stays open for a month. Then it doesn't.
items.neu: That's a first. Most people at least negotiate. The door stays open for a month. Then it doesn't.

items.alt: „Ich rede erst mit meiner Crew.“
items.neu: “I'll talk to my crew first.”

items.alt: Your crew. Interesting. Most people ask their partner. Friday, then.
items.neu: Your crew. Interesting. Most people ask their partner. Friday, then.

items.alt: Köln: Freitag
items.neu: Cologne: Friday

items.alt: Katrin Vogel ruft wieder an. Es ist so weit. Draußen streiten sich Lola und Rosi gerade lautstark um den letzten Kaffee.
items.neu: Katrin Vogel calls again. It's time. Outside, Lola and Rosi are loudly fighting over the last coffee.

items.alt: It's Friday. The board meets in an hour. What do I tell them?
items.neu: It's Friday. The board meets in an hour. What do I tell them?

items.alt: For the record: they've stopped looking. It's you or they start over. No pressure. A lot of pressure.
items.neu: For the record: they've stopped looking. It's you, or they start over. No pressure. A lot of pressure.

items.alt: Zusagen
items.neu: Say yes.

items.alt: Congratulations. You'll start in six weeks. Bring a coat, Cologne isn't the Mediterranean.
items.neu: Congratulations. You start in six weeks. Bring a coat, Cologne isn't the Mediterranean.

items.alt: Absagen
items.neu: Turns it down.

items.alt: Understood. I hope the sea is worth it. Sometimes it is.
items.neu: Understood. I hope the sea is worth it. Sometimes it is.

items.alt: Auf Lautsprecher stellen und die Crew mithören lassen
items.neu: Puts it on speaker so the crew can listen.

items.alt: Wait. WAIT. Cologne? You were going to leave? Duc! We need a meeting. With snacks.
items.neu: Wait. WAIT. Cologne? You were going to leave? Boss! We need a meeting. With snacks.

items.alt: Die Generalprobe
items.neu: The Dress Rehearsal

items.alt: Madame Casanova probt ihren Auftritt für die Festa. Im Flamenco-Kleid, auf einem Fischkutter, mit einer gemieteten Nebelmaschine. Der Nebel ist dichter als geplant. Der ganze Hafen ist weiß. Irgendwo darin hupt Elsas Patrouillenboot.
items.neu: Madame Casanova is rehearsing her festa entrance. In a flamenco dress, on a fishing boat, with a hired fog machine. The fog is thicker than planned. The whole harbour has gone white. Somewhere in it, Elsa's patrol boat is sounding its horn.

items.alt: ihr Boot im Nebel
items.neu: her boat is lost in the fog

items.alt: verkauft Plätze
items.neu: is selling seats

items.alt: hat nichts gesehen
items.neu: saw nothing

items.alt: Behold! The mayor rises from the mists of Corsica! ...Is it working? I can't see anything. Perfect.
items.neu: Behold! The mayor rises from the mists of Corsica! …Is it working? I can't see anything. Perfect.

items.alt: Madame. I can't see my own bow. Turn. It. Off.
items.neu: Madame. I can't see my own bow. Turn. It. Off.

items.alt: Front row in the fog, ten euro! Second row, five! You see nothing, but you see nothing first!
items.neu: Front row in the fog, ten euros! Second row, five! You see nothing, but you see nothing first!

items.alt: Die Nebelmaschine reparieren, damit sie dosiert
items.neu: Fixes the fog machine so it doses properly.

items.alt: A gentle mist! A mysterious mist! You have given me the gift of drama, First Officer!
items.neu: A gentle mist! A mysterious mist! You have given me the gift of drama, Monsieur!

items.alt: Laut applaudieren, bis sie verbeugt
items.neu: Applauds loudly until she bows.

items.alt: The people love me! Even the ones I cannot see!
items.neu: The people love me! Even the ones I cannot see!

items.alt: Elsa zum Boot lotsen
items.neu: Guides Elsa back to her boat.

items.alt: ...Thank you. Tell her the fog machine is now evidence.
items.neu: …Thank you. Tell her the fog machine is now evidence.

items.alt: Petrus Untermieter
items.neu: Petru's Lodger

items.alt: Petru hat beim Liefern einen Eimer an Bord vergessen. Im Eimer war ein Oktopus, den er seit Wochen füttert und „Bastianu“ nennt. Jetzt ist der Eimer leer. Lola steht mit einem Kochlöffel in der Kombüse und schwört, sie hat nur nachgesehen. Aus dem Spülbecken winkt ein Arm.
items.neu: Petru left a bucket on board when he made his delivery. In the bucket was an octopus he's been feeding for weeks and calls Bastianu. Now the bucket is empty. Lola is standing in the galley with a wooden spoon, swearing she only had a look. An arm waves from the sink.

items.alt: sucht seinen Freund
items.neu: is looking for his friend

items.alt: Tinte auf der Uniform
items.neu: ink on her uniform

items.alt: wittert Calamari
items.neu: smells calamari

items.alt: Okay, so, in my defence, he looked hungry. And then he looked at the garlic. And then he was GONE.
items.neu: Okay, so, in my defence, he looked hungry. And then he looked at the garlic. And then he was GONE.

items.alt: Bastianu. Come.
items.neu: Bastianu. Come here.

items.alt: Comandante, think about it. Garlic is already there. Destiny is calling.
items.neu: Comandante, think about it. The garlic is already here. Destiny is calling.

items.alt: Bastianu sanft zurück in den Eimer locken
items.neu: Gently coaxes Bastianu back into the bucket.

items.alt: ...Grazie. He likes you. He never likes anybody.
items.neu: …Grazie. He likes you. He never likes anybody.

items.alt: Totò klar machen: Freunde isst man nicht
items.neu: Makes it clear to Totò: you don't eat friends.

items.alt: Fine! Fine. I will eat my feelings. Also not octopus.
items.neu: Fine! Fine. I will eat my feelings. Also not octopus.

items.alt: Lola den Oktopus zeichnen lassen, bis Petru ihn holt
items.neu: Lets Lola draw the octopus until Petru collects him.

items.alt: Look, I gave him eyebrows. He's thrilled. He's not thrilled. He's an octopus.
items.neu: Look, I gave him eyebrows. He's thrilled. He's not thrilled. He's an octopus.

items.alt: Kartoffeln, die miauen
items.neu: Potatoes That Meow

items.alt: Elsa hat eine von Totòs Kisten am Kai aufgehalten. Auf der Kiste steht „Kartoffeln“. Die Kiste miaut. Totò behauptet, es seien sehr junge Kartoffeln. Elsa hat ihr Notizbuch schon gezückt.
items.neu: Elsa has stopped one of Totò's crates on the quay. The crate says “Potatoes”. The crate meows. Totò claims they're very young potatoes. Elsa has already pulled out her notebook.

items.alt: Monsieur Esposito. Potatoes do not purr.
items.neu: Monsieur Esposito. Potatoes do not purr.

items.alt: Corsican potatoes, Lieutenant. Very emotional. It is the soil.
items.neu: Corsican potatoes, Lieutenant. Very emotional. It's the soil.

items.alt: Open it, o figliolu. If it's a cat, I'm keeping it. If it's potatoes, I'm keeping those too.
items.neu: Open it. If it's a cat, I'm keeping it. If it's potatoes, I'm keeping those too.

items.alt: Elsa beistehen: aufmachen
items.neu: Backs Elsa: open it.

items.alt: A kitten. Three kittens. Esposito, you are smuggling kittens.
items.neu: A kitten. Three kittens. Esposito, you are smuggling kittens.

items.alt: Totò decken: „Das sind meine Kartoffeln“
items.neu: Covers for Totò: “Those are my potatoes.”

items.alt: Comandante! A man of honour! ...They are kittens, by the way. For my nonna.
items.neu: Comandante! A man of honour! …They are kittens, by the way. For my nonna.

items.alt: Vorschlagen, die Kätzchen dem Dorf zu schenken
items.neu: Suggests giving the kittens to the village.

items.alt: The official cats of the festa! I declare it! Somebody write it down!
items.neu: The official cats of the festa! I declare it! Somebody write it down!

items.alt: Megan isst mit
items.neu: Megan Joins Dinner

items.alt: Megan ruft während des Crew-Essens an und verlangt, auf einen Stuhl gestellt zu werden. „Teambuilding.“ Lola legt eine Serviette vor den Laptop und füllt Megan Pasta auf einen Teller, den niemand isst.
items.neu: Megan calls during the crew dinner and demands to be put on a chair. “Team building.” Lola puts a napkin in front of the laptop and serves Megan a plate of pasta that nobody will eat.

items.alt: Put me at the head of the table. Yes. There. Now everyone may look at me while they eat.
items.neu: Put me at the head of the table. Yes. There. Now everyone may look at me while they eat.

items.alt: Mwahaha. That was a laugh. I'm told laughing builds trust. Is it working?
items.neu: Mwahaha. That was a laugh. I'm told laughing builds trust. Is it working?

items.alt: Einen Toast auf Megan ausbringen
items.neu: Raises a toast to Megan.

items.alt: To me. How thoughtful. I'm writing it in your file. The nice part of your file.
items.neu: To me. How thoughtful. I'm writing it in your file. The nice part of your file.

items.alt: Sie die Pasta „probieren“ lassen
items.neu: Lets her “taste” the pasta.

items.alt: ...Don't tell anyone I laughed. If this leaks, I'll know it was you.
items.neu: …Don't tell anyone I laughed. If this leaks, I'll know it was you.

items.alt: Höflich auflegen, damit die Crew in Ruhe isst
items.neu: Politely hangs up so the crew can eat in peace.

items.alt: Flamenco mit der Bürgermeisterin
items.neu: Flamenco with the Mayor

items.alt: Die Piazza ist leer, die Lichterketten der Festa hängen noch. Madame Casanova steht im roten Flamenco-Kleid unter dem Brunnen, ein altes Kofferradio zu ihren Füßen. Sie hat dich herbestellt, „für eine Lektion im Namen der Gemeinde“. Dann schaltet sie das Radio ein und hört auf, Bürgermeisterin zu sein.
items.neu: The piazza is empty, the festa lights still strung up. Madame Casanova stands by the fountain in a red flamenco dress, an old portable radio at her feet. She summoned you “for a lesson on behalf of the municipality”. Then she switches on the radio and stops being the mayor.

items.alt: Tonight there is no mayor. No festa. No speeches. ...Well. Maybe one speech. A short one.
items.neu: Tonight there is no mayor. No festa. No speeches. …Well. Maybe one speech. A short one.

items.alt: Flamenco is not dancing, First Officer. It is a conversation where nobody is allowed to lie.
items.neu: Flamenco is not dancing, Monsieur. It is a conversation where nobody is allowed to lie.

items.alt: Give me your hand. If you want to stop, you stop. If you don't... we see where the music goes.
items.neu: Give me your hand. If you want to stop, you stop. If you don't… we'll see where the music goes.

items.alt: Ihre Hand nehmen und sie führen lassen
items.neu: Takes her hand and lets her lead.

items.alt: Good. Now listen to the guitar. Your feet will lie. Your hands won't.
items.neu: Good. Now listen to the guitar. Your feet will lie. Your hands won't.

items.alt: Mit ihr tanzen, nur tanzen
items.neu: Dances with her, just dances.

items.alt: Only dancing. Yes. That is also a conversation. A beautiful one.
items.neu: Only dancing. Yes. That is also a conversation. A beautiful one.

items.alt: „Heute nicht, Madame.“
items.neu: “Not tonight, Madame.”

items.alt: Then the music waits. Like the whole village waits for me. Patiently. Dramatically.
items.neu: Then the music waits. The way the whole village waits for me. Patiently. Dramatically.

items.neu: Voice Message from Megan (1)

items.alt: Eine Sprachnachricht, 23:58. Im Hintergrund das Büro in Frankfurt, alle Lichter an, nur ihres nicht aus.
items.neu: A voice message, 23:58. In the background, the office in Monaco: every light switched off except hers.

items.alt: First Officer. It is midnight. I am still in the office. Do you know why? Because my yacht is sitting in a bay with no engine and no explanation.
items.neu: First Officer. It is midnight. I am still in the office. Do you know why? Because my yacht is sitting in a bay with no engine and no explanation.

items.alt: Five days. Then I want a name. Goodnight. I won't sleep. Neither should you.
items.neu: Five days. Then I want a name. Goodnight. I won't sleep. Neither should you.

items.alt: Zurückschreiben: „Verstanden.“
items.neu: Texts back: “Understood.”

items.alt: Rosi vorspielen
items.neu: Plays it to Rosi.

items.alt: No engine. She said no engine. It's an inverter! Somebody tell Frankfurt it's an inverter!
items.neu: No engine. She said no engine. It's an inverter! Somebody tell Monaco it's an inverter!

items.alt: Löschen und schlafen gehen
items.neu: Deletes it and goes to bed.

items.neu: Voice Message from Megan (2)

items.alt: Sprachnachricht, 06:02. Megan ist seit vier Uhr wach. Man hört es.
items.neu: A voice message, 06:02. Megan has been up since four. You can hear it.

items.alt: Good morning. I made a spreadsheet. It has one column. The column says: who.
items.neu: Good morning. I made a spreadsheet. It has one column. The column says: who.

items.alt: It is empty, First Officer. EMPTY. Four days.
items.neu: It is empty, First Officer. EMPTY. Four days.

items.alt: Zurückschreiben: „Die Spalte füllt sich.“
items.neu: Texts back: “The column is filling up.”

items.alt: Ein Foto vom Sonnenaufgang schicken
items.neu: Sends her a photo of the sunrise.

items.alt: Is that a sunrise? Did you send me a SUNRISE? I am adding a second column.
items.neu: Is that a sunrise? Did you send me a SUNRISE? I am adding a second column.

items.alt: Nicht antworten
items.neu: Doesn't answer.

items.neu: Voice Message from Megan (3)

items.alt: Sprachnachricht, 07:15. Megan kommt gerade aus einer Vorstandssitzung. Im Hintergrund klappert eine Kaffeemaschine sehr laut.
items.neu: A voice message, 07:15. Megan has just come out of a board meeting. In the background, a coffee machine rattles very loudly.

items.alt: I just told the board the Eden Bay Weekend is still a success. I said it with a smile. My face still hurts.
items.neu: I just told the board the Eden Bay Weekend is still a success. I said it with a smile. My face still hurts.

items.alt: Three days. And tell your cook to stop sending me pictures of breakfast. They look good. It is unacceptable.
items.neu: Three days. And tell your cook to stop sending me pictures of breakfast. They look good. It is unacceptable.

items.alt: Lola ausrichten lassen
items.neu: Passes it on to Lola.

items.alt: She said they look good? Boss, she said they look GOOD. I'm framing this.
items.neu: She said they look good? Boss, she said they look GOOD. I'm framing this.

items.alt: Zurückschreiben: „Sie bekommen Ihren Namen.“
items.neu: Texts back: “You'll get your name.”

items.alt: Zurückschreiben: „Sie bekommen die Wahrheit.“
items.neu: Texts back: “You'll get the truth.”

items.neu: Voice Message from Megan (4)

items.neu: A voice message, 07:40. Rotor noise. Megan is shouting over a helicopter.

items.alt: I am in a helicopter. I hate helicopters. I hate them less than your reports.
items.neu: I am in a helicopter. I hate helicopters. I hate them less than your reports.

items.alt: Landing at eleven. I want coffee, a clean deck, and nobody smiling at me. Two days.
items.neu: Landing at eleven. I want coffee, a clean deck, and nobody smiling at me. Two days.

items.alt: Chiara Bescheid geben
items.neu: Lets Chiara know.

items.alt: Eleven. Coffee. Clean deck. No smiling. I can do three of those.
items.neu: Eleven. Coffee. Clean deck. No smiling. I can do three of those.

items.neu: Lets Maxwell know.

items.neu: A helicopter? Mr. Maximum will greet it. From behind the anchor locker. Very respectfully.

items.alt: Zurückschreiben: „Kaffee steht bereit.“
items.neu: Texts back: “Coffee will be ready.”

items.neu: Voice Message from Megan (5)

items.alt: I am one deck above you. This is a voice message because if I walk down those stairs, I will fire someone on the way.
items.neu: I am one deck above you. This is a voice message because if I walk down those stairs, I will fire someone on the way.

items.alt: Tomorrow. Eleven o'clock. The salon. Bring proof. Not feelings.
items.neu: Tomorrow. Eleven o'clock. The salon. Bring proof. Not feelings.

items.neu: Goes up the stairs and knocks.

items.alt: You came up. Nobody comes up. …Sit. You have four minutes.
items.neu: You came up. Nobody comes up. …Sit. You have four minutes.

items.neu: Texts back: “Eleven o'clock.”

items.neu: Plays the message to Totò.

items.alt: Comandante, I run a book. Odds she fires somebody before lunch: two to one. You want in?
items.neu: Comandante, I run a book. Odds she fires somebody before lunch: two to one. You want in?

items.neu: Good morning. Today I listen. Only today.

items.alt: Make it count, First Officer.
items.neu: Make it count, First Officer.

items.alt: Tief durchatmen
items.neu: Takes a deep breath.

items.neu: Texts back: “I will.”

items.neu: Your tenth win against Maxwell. Down at the railing stands Jana with two bottles of water, forgetting that one of them was meant for Maxwell. She turns red when you look at her.

items.alt: grins
items.neu: grins

items.alt: hebt eine Braue
items.neu: raises an eyebrow

items.alt: Sorry, I- that was really- you just- I brought water. For you. Both. Both are for you.
items.neu: Sorry, I– that was really– you just– I brought water. For you. Both. Both are for you.

items.alt: Maximum sees everything, little sister. Maximum also sees that Maximum gets no water.
items.neu: Mr. Maximum sees everything, little sister. Mr. Maximum also sees that Mr. Maximum gets no water.

items.neu: Takes a bottle and winks at her.

items.alt: Na geh... okay. Okay. I'm going to go stand somewhere else now.
items.neu: Na geh… okay. Okay. I'm going to go and stand somewhere else now.

items.alt: Ihr anbieten, beim nächsten Training mitzumachen

items.alt: Me? Fighting? ...Will you show me how to stand like that?
items.neu: Me? Fighting? …Will you show me how to stand like that?

items.alt: Maxwell die zweite Flasche geben
items.neu: Gives Maxwell the second bottle.

items.alt: THANK you, brother. Jana, Maximum forgives you.
items.neu: THANK you, brother. Jana, Mr. Maximum forgives you.

items.alt: Chiara hat zugesehen
items.neu: Chiara Was Watching

items.alt: Dritte Niederlage. Du liegst auf dem Teak und schaust in den Himmel. Ein Schatten fällt über dich: Chiara, Arme verschränkt, die Uniform makellos. Sie hat alles gesehen.
items.neu: Your third defeat. You're lying on the teak, looking up at the sky. A shadow falls over you: Chiara, arms folded, uniform immaculate. She saw everything.

items.alt: will vermitteln
items.neu: wants to mediate

items.alt: First Officer. You are aware that he is on our side? He was going easy on you. I could tell.
items.neu: First Officer. You are aware that he's on our side? He was going easy on you. I could tell.
